messages:
sam: customer report — corp card declined at checkout on invoice INV-5583. cardholder says card works elsewhere. merchant shows as 'Tax Filing Services'. customer needs to pay today.
jess: can you paste the gateway/raw payment response? also which card (Visa/Amex) and last4?
sam: Amex ending 4242. raw response below:
```
{
  "error": "card_declined",
  "decline_code": "mcc_blocked",
  "bank_message": "MCC_PROHIBITED",
  "merchant_mcc": "9311",
  "amount": 1200,
  "currency": "USD",
  "transaction_id": "txn_01Gq9z2x"
}
```
jess: 9311 maps to tax-related services, yep. are they on a corporate spend policy that blocks that MCC?
maria: looked into account: company_id cc-998 has policy: corporate_mcc_restrictions = ["5311", "9311"] and single_txn_limit = 1000. this charge was 1200 so it hits both the MCC disallow and the single_txn_limit. see admin audit: policy last updated 2025-08-02 by finance-bot.
alex: two separate failure reasons then: (1) MCC is prohibited, (2) exceeds single transaction cap. gateway returns MCC_PROHIBITED which is dominant. we need to confirm which rule should be relaxed. ask customer if they can split invoice or use a personal card.
sam: customer says they cannot split and only have corp Amex. they asked if purchase could be whitelisted temporarily.
finance-bot: To request an MCC whitelist for a customer you must submit a signed PO change request and an internal approval. I can open a request if provided: company_id, merchant_name, merchant_mcc, invoice_id, justification.
jess: escalate to finance for temporary allowlist + to payments for bank-level decline support. payments-bot, can you attach bank decline trace for txn_01Gq9z2x?
payments-bot: attached trace: bank_response_code=57, bank_text="transaction not permitted to cardholder", acquirer=acq-amex-us, trace_id=trc_7Yb. Also note: tokenization shows card_network=amex, issuer_country=US.
alex: bank_response_code 57 often means merchant category not permitted by issuer. We should: 1) advise finance to request internal MCC override for this company and 2) ask customer to contact their card admin/issuing bank to allow MCC 9311, or use alternative payment method.
maria: repro steps for support if needed:
1) recreate invoice INV-5583 with merchant_mcc=9311 and amount=1200
2) use card token from customer or test Amex token
3) POST /v1/payments with body:
```
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-5583",
  "amount": 1200,
  "currency": "USD",
  "card_token": "tok_amex_4242"
}
```
check response for decline_code and debug_id.
jess: for short-term unblock options: (A) finance issue an allowlist for merchant_mcc 9311 for this company (B) reduce invoice to be <=1000 to fit tx limit (C) accept manual bank transfer / wire.
sam: customer asked if we can do (A) immediately — what info do finance need? also any compliance risk whitelisting tax services?
finance-bot: required: company_id cc-998, merchant_name exact, merchant_mcc 9311, invoice id, authorized approver name & email, business justification. Compliance note: whitelisting MCC 9311 requires AML review if amounts exceed threshold; for one-off 1200 it's low risk but flag if recurring.
alex: assigning: finance (maria) to open MCC override ticket with support-proc, payments (jess) to request acquirer trace & escalate to issuer if needed, sam to keep customer updated. create internal ticket INT-3421 and link to support case CASE-9098.
jess: leaving suggested message for customer — short and actionable:
"We can request a temporary allowlist for the merchant MCC from your company admin and also submit an escalation to the card issuer. To proceed we need a signed PO amendment or approval from your finance admin (name + email). If you can provide that we’ll start the override request — otherwise you can pay with a different card or wire today."
sam: will send message to customer, collecting approver email now. tagging finance-bot once I have it :eyes:
payments-bot: updating ticket INT-3421 with trace_id trc_7Yb and gateway logs. If issuer provides an explicit MCC block code we'll update decline mapping to show "issuer_mcc_block" for clarity.
maria: noted. I'll open the MCC override request and loop in compliance for sign-off. target turnaround ~24-48h. will update CASE-9098 when done.
jess: thanks team. if the customer needs immediate access to product, offer manual invoice + wire instructions as fallback. closing actions: finance=open override request, payments=issuer escalation, support=customer comms (sam).
